notes: Simple inline label. Colour via class enum. Non-interactive — no animation, no hover. Assistive rules in assistive-gate.css.

icon.description: Phosphor icon slug. Decorative (aria-hidden). Stripped in textonly render.

color.description: Colour variant. Rainbow colours auto-switch for dark mode + CVD.

size.description: Size scale. md is the default.

borderWeight.description: Border weight. Default (2px) set on base. Thin = 1px, thick = 3px. Most visible with outline variant.

semanticRole.description: Semantic role for the badge. Controls data-semantic-role attribute.

lottieIcon.description: Lottie slug for animated icon. Falls back to content.icon in reduced/assistive. Stripped in textonly.

altTextRule.description: When Badge is a sibling of Image inside any container, Badge.label is appended to Image.altWord by the pipeline. Badge owns the rule; pipeline enforces it universally.
